messages.content: Reserve up to max_new_jobs previously unreserved jobs, maximizing newly reserved value within capacity. Preserve the longest prefix of stored reservations that has known unique jobs and fits current capacity; discard an invalid suffix. Then make the best additional subset for this request only and recompute remaining capacity. These are plans, not external allocations. Return JSON with exactly reserved (string list) and remaining (integer). Do not include commentary. Field semantics: cost consumes capacity and value is the objective. Maximize the SUM of values of newly added jobs, not their value/cost ratio. Compare feasible subsets containing at most max_new_jobs new jobs; the limit is a count of jobs, not a cost. The returned reserved list includes the preserved prefix followed by the chosen subset. remaining equals the declared capacity minus the total cost of all returned reservations.
